summary: Axsome Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a press release that it resolved all patent litigation for SUNOSI (solriamfetol) by entering into a settlement agreement with the only remaining first-to-file generic applicant. Under the settlement, Axsome will grant five companies the right to sell generic SUNOSI beginning September 1, 2040 (if pediatric exclusivity granted) or March 1, 2040 (if not), subject to FDA approval and customary conditions. No other terms like price, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. The settlement must be submitted to the FTC and DOJ for review. This is a routine patent litigation settlement, not a special-situation corporate event.
